About Roadside Assistance
-------------------------

Roadside assistance providers are obviously very essential for everyone, irrespective of what make or model of car they drive. Whether it's a brand-new car it may nevertheless have problems so it'd be a nice improvement to know that roadside aid is available during any time of night or day. Roadside assistance could be bought as a monthly subscription at an extremely reasonable fee, approximately $30, based upon the service provider and on the extra providers included in the contract, or you could select to pay a fee when you need the service. You should always think about that on call breakdown towing and services are very expensive.  
  
If you know you are going to travel a lot, thus the possibility of something actually going wrong is higher, then no doubt you should consider paying for the monthly/yearly subscription, but if you only drive few miles per month and own a vehicle known to be reliable maybe the second option would be the one to choose. Automotive roadside aid covers tons of things, mechanical failures, accidents and everything which prevents your car from going under its own power.  
  
Certainly, and luckily, vehicle accidents are not occurring very often, but what about break downs? You often find individuals on the street waiting to get someone to stop by and take a take a look at their car, or awaiting the pickup truck to tow their car into the closest garage to have it fixed. If you wish to avoid such situations you could make the clever choice to buy a road service contract, quotes are free so that you may readily see how much you would need to pay to get national roadside coverage. About Neelima Gaddam

Neelima Gaddam is a seasoned professional with over 20 years of experience at the intersection of fintech, data, and technology, currently serving as the Senior Director of Product Management at Visa. In her current role, Neelima leads the Installments and Embedded Finance division, where she is instrumental in shaping innovative financial solutions that enhance customer experiences and drive business growth. Au cours des dernières années, nous distribuons également des fenêtres et porte-patios. Pendant plus de 4 décennies, nous sommes pleinement engagés dans la qualité et l’innovation, tout en procurant une valeur exceptionnelle à nos clients.  
  
Nos produits sont vendus dans 35 pays à travers le monde avec production 24 jours sur 7 et cinquante-et-une semaines par année. Nous opérons plus de 4 000 000 pieds carrés d’usines de fabrication dans dix-huit usines et 2 500 000 pieds carrés d’espace de distribution dans plus de 50 centres à travers l’Amérique du Nord.

After an initial review, selected startups may be invited for further discussions and presentations.

About Distretto Dolomiti Occhiale
---------------------------------

Chi siamo  
La storia del Distretto inizia nel 1878 con il primo insediamento di una fabbrica di occhiali a Calalzo di Cadore, tra le Dolomiti Patrimonio dell’Umanità. Oggi la sua estensione coincide con il territorio di tutta la provincia di Belluno, arrivando nelle province di Treviso, Padova e Venezia. Il Distretto vanta un’altissima specializzazione in tutte le produzioni: montature, minuterie, macchinari ed attrezzature di produzione, trattamenti galvanici, astucci e lenti. Oltre 300 imprese di piccole, medie e grandi dimensioni che impiegano oltre 12 mila addetti. Tra queste anche le aziende leader a livello mondiale.  
  
La nostra mission  
Incentivare la crescita del “saper fare”, dell’innovazione, della creatività e della sostenibilità, anche attraverso le connessioni che favoriscono lo scambio di competenze, conoscenze e informazioni. Favorire la crescita delle aziende, in particolare con azioni a sostegno dell’internazionalizzazione.  
  
Obiettivi  
Espressione del Made in Italy, l’occhiale è cultura, design, innovazione, know how da tramandare; fattori, questi, che hanno contribuito a consolidare la leadership mondiale del distretto e che, proprio per questo, vanno ulteriormente valorizzati in un’ottica di sistema temporale.

About The Broadmoor
-------------------

The Broadmoor, located at the foothills of the Rocky Mountains in Colorado Springs, is the longest consecutive winner of the Forbes Five-Star and AAA Five-Diamond awards for excellence in service and facilities. Opened in 1918, The Broadmoor covers 5,000 acres with 784 hotel rooms and suites surrounding Cheyenne Lake.  
  
The Broadmoor offers over 315,000 square feet of flexible, functional, and sophisticated event and convention space, meeting areas of all sizes, and over 100 years of award-winning hospitality. The new 125,000-square-foot Bartolin Hall, ideal for exhibits and breakout sessions, forms part of the 184,500-square-foot “Convention Center at The Broadmoor,” along with existing Broadmoor Hall, International Center, and Colorado Hall. The Broadmoor’s history of innovation, combined with a distinctive service culture and exceptional team building opportunities has made it one of the country’s premier event destinations.  
  
The resort offers two championship golf courses, a Forbes Five-Star spa, year round tennis, and unique fishing opportunities. Twenty distinct dining offerings, including the coveted Forbes Five-Star, AAA Five-Diamond restaurant Penrose Room, 24 specialty boutiques, and a fitness facility, which includes indoor and outdoor pools, complete the lavish resort experience.  
  
To complete the authentic Colorado experience, The Broadmoor has three unique properties within minutes of the resort grounds; Cloud Camp, a mountain retreat with 22 accommodations in the main lodge and luxurious mountain cabins; The Ranch at Emerald Valley is situated in a lush valley and features horseback riding, fishing, hiking and archery; The Fly Fishing Camp along the Tarryall River is the epitome of fishing luxury, seven cabins and a main lodge round out a one of a kind experience.  
  
The Broadmoor is known for the service and dedication of its employees. This is reinforced by its '16 Standards of Service' which promotes exceptional experiences for its guests.

About Henry Fonda

Henry Fonda was an American actor best known for his iconic roles in films such as "The Grapes of Wrath," "12 Angry Men," and "On Golden Pond." Born in 1905 in Grand Island, Nebraska, Fonda was raised in a family with strong roots in the American heartland, and that upbringing would play a significant role in shaping his on-screen persona.  
  
Fonda made his mark on the world of theater and film during the Golden Age of Hollywood, with a career that spanned over five decades. Known for his understated but powerful performances, Fonda had a remarkable ability to convey emotion with subtlety and authenticity. His screen presence was magnetic, and audiences were drawn to his everyman charm and commanding presence.  
  
One of Fonda's most memorable performances came in the 1940 film adaptation of John Steinbeck's novel "The Grapes of Wrath." Fonda's portrayal of Tom Joad, a dispossessed Oklahoman who becomes a symbol of resilience and dignity amidst hardship, earned him critical acclaim and solidified his status as a leading man in Hollywood. Throughout his career, Fonda brought to life a wide range of characters, from flawed but noble juror in "12 Angry Men" to the conflicted patriarch in "On Golden Pond."  
  
Fonda's contributions to American cinema were not limited to his work in front of the camera. In 1948, he co-founded the prestigious Actors Studio in New York City, an institution that played a pivotal role in shaping the future of method acting. Through his dedication to his craft, Fonda inspired generations of actors and left an indelible mark on the industry.  
  
Beyond his achievements in film and theater, Fonda was also known for his activism and political outspokenness. Throughout his life, he was a fierce advocate for social justice and civil rights, and he used his platform to speak out against inequality and discrimination. Fonda's commitment to his principles and his willingness to speak out on controversial issues made him a respected figure both on and off screen.  
  
In 1981, Fonda's career came full circle with his role in "On Golden Pond," a poignant drama that explored themes of aging, family, and forgiveness. The film, which also starred Fonda's daughter, Jane, and Katharine Hepburn, was a critical and commercial success, earning Fonda his first and only Academy Award for Best Actor. The role of an aging, cantankerous father allowed Fonda to showcase his range as an actor, and his performance resonated with audiences and critics alike.  
  
Despite his illustrious career, Fonda remained humble and dedicated to his craft until the very end. His legacy as an actor and activist continues to inspire and influence the world of entertainment and beyond. Henry Fonda passed away in 1982, leaving behind a rich body of work that remains a testament to his talent and enduring impact on American cinema.  
  
In conclusion, Henry Fonda was a beloved and respected figure in the world of entertainment, known for his versatile performances and unwavering commitment to his principles. With a career that spanned over five decades, Fonda left an indelible mark on the industry and continues to be celebrated for his iconic roles and contributions to American cinema. About KoJa Kitchen
------------------

KoJa Kitchen began as food truck in 2011, founded by Alan Tsai, Hiep Lien, and two other partners, who all have a passion for culinary innovation. The name "KoJa", a shorthand for Korean-Japanese, was born from the founders’ desires to reinvent the way that Korean and Japanese cuisine is traditionally prepared and to create a unique Asian fusion concept that is both fun and delicious. From the get-go, KoJa Kitchen took the San Francisco foodie scene by storm with their signature creation, a burger made with garlic-flavored rice buns and meats seasoned with KoJa Kitchen's unique sauce No. 96™. With growing popularity, KoJa Kitchen opened their first brick and mortar restaurant in 2014.  
  
KoJa Kitchen continually strives to bring guests with the best customer service and dining experience. The entire KoJa Kitchen family would like to graciously thank you for your continued patronage!

About Tim Huntley

As the CEO of Centervention, Tim Huntley is at the forefront of revolutionizing the educational landscape for K-8 students by leveraging innovative technology to enhance social, emotional, and behavioral skills. Under his leadership, Centervention has transformed from its original identity as Personalized Learning Games into a pioneering EdTech startup that harnesses the power of online gaming to create engaging and effective learning experiences. The games, developed with substantial backing from the Department of Education and the National Science Foundation, are designed to adapt to the unique needs of each student, ensuring personalized pathways to success.  
  
Tim's expertise in entrepreneurship and strategic partnerships has been instrumental in driving the company's mission to provide educators with robust tools for assessing and improving students' social and emotional competencies. By focusing on game-based interventions that have been validated through randomized controlled trials, Centervention not only demonstrates the effectiveness of its products but also positions itself as a leader in the EdTech space. The results speak for themselves, showcasing significant improvements in student outcomes, which are crucial for both academic achievement and overall well-being.  
  
In addition to his strategic vision, Tim's background in software development and SaaS solutions has enabled Centervention to create a scalable platform that meets the evolving needs of educators and students alike. His commitment to fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement ensures that Centervention remains at the cutting edge of educational technology, making a lasting impact on the lives of young learners. Through his leadership, Tim Huntley is not only shaping the future of education but also championing the importance of social and emotional learning in creating well-rounded, resilient students.

What types of trucking services does Rogers Dedicated Services offer?

Rogers Dedicated Services provides a range of trucking solutions, including On-Demand trucking for immediate transportation needs and Dedicated Contract Carriage for clients requiring consistent and reliable service. Our fleet is equipped to handle various cargo types, ensuring timely and safe deliveries across the Atlanta area and beyond.

How does the On-Demand trucking service work?

Our On-Demand trucking service is designed for flexibility and speed. Customers can request transportation services as needed, and we will dispatch a truck to your location promptly. This service is ideal for businesses with fluctuating shipping demands or urgent delivery requirements. You can easily place an order through our website or by contacting our customer service team.

What is Dedicated Contract Carriage and how can it benefit my business?

Dedicated Contract Carriage is a tailored trucking solution where we manage the transportation needs of your business on a long-term basis. This service includes dedicated trucks and drivers assigned to your operations, ensuring reliability and consistency. Benefits include reduced transportation costs, improved service levels, and the ability to focus on your core business while we handle logistics.

What industries does Rogers Dedicated Services support?

Rogers Dedicated Services supports a variety of industries, including retail, manufacturing, food and beverage, and e-commerce. Our versatile trucking solutions can be customized to meet the specific needs of each sector, ensuring efficient transportation and logistics management tailored to your business requirements.

How can I get a quote for your trucking services?

To receive a quote for our trucking services, you can fill out the request form on our website or contact our sales team directly. Please provide details such as the type of service you need (On-Demand or Dedicated Contract Carriage), the nature of the cargo, pickup and delivery locations, and any specific requirements. Our team will respond promptly with a competitive quote.

What measures does Rogers Dedicated Services take to ensure the safety of my cargo?

At Rogers Dedicated Services, the safety of your cargo is our top priority. We implement rigorous safety protocols, including regular maintenance of our fleet, thorough driver training, and adherence to industry regulations. Additionally, our trucks are equipped with tracking systems, allowing you to monitor your shipment in real-time and ensuring peace of mind throughout the transportation process.

H+ K Financial is a joint venture between Buchanan, one of the world’s leading financial communications consultancies and H+K Strategies, the Middle East and Africa region’s (MEA) longest established international communications consultancy, in the Middle East and Africa (MEA).  
  
H+K Financial addresses the growing demand for world class financial communications and investor relations services in MEA as companies seek to raise their profiles and gain access to international capital markets, while upgrading their corporate governance. The firm will also provide international investors access to growth opportunities in the region.  
  
With 15 offices H+K Financial is the region’s largest, most experienced and most influential financial communications firm. It also provides access for MEA companies to reach major global capital markets through its network offices in London, New York, Tokyo, Singapore and Shanghai, among others.  
  
Buchanan’s specialist advisors have teamed up with H+K’s MEA investor relations certified practitioners to provide full corporate and financial communications services, providing advisory services on transactions including Initial Public Offerings (IPOs), fund raises, mergers and acquisitions and corporate restructurings.  
In addition, the offer includes bespoke investor relations services from shareholder register analysis and investor access, through to annual report, corporate governance and financial transparency communications. These services, along with the core corporate and reputation management services, are now provided in all of the main hubs throughout the H+K MEA network to current and prospective clients.  
  
H+K Financial will work with H+K’s global network of 87 offices to deliver a truly global financial communications offering. With direct access through WPP, H+K and Buchanan’s parent company, H+K Financial also offers clients broader services including advertising, branding and media buying.

About Levered Learning
----------------------

Levered is a teacher-designed, classroom-tested instructional system for 3rd-5th grade mathematics. Our competency-based online curriculum allows students to move at their own pace, filling in gaps in prior knowledge, and pushing beyond the standards for kids who need extra challenge.  
  
We want teachers to focus on teaching, not grading & data entry. Under the hood, Levered activities correspond to Common Core standards giving an unprecedented level of data-driven intervention support and actionable data for teachers.  
  
Most public school districts are linked in both budget and resources with test data performance, while available solutions offer few measurable results. Levered is designed from the ground up to improve outcomes for English Learners, and all students—schools that used Levered in 4th grade in 2018 increased the percent of student exceeding state standards by double digits while shrinking the "standard not met" pool by an average of 50%.  
  
As a full classroom system, Levered delivers value beyond the sum of its parts.  
  
• Individually paced, adaptive online curriculum  
• Multi-standard collaborative pencil & paper challenges  
• Integrated whole class activities  
• Data-driven intervention support for struggling students  
  
Despite a flood of ed-tech math programs,  60% of 4th graders in California don't meet standards, growing to nearly 70% by 5th grade. Students using Levered in schools in California in 2017-2018 exceeded state growth by 170%.

What is Levered Learning and how does it support elementary education?

Levered Learning is a teacher-designed, classroom-tested instructional system specifically tailored for 3rd to 5th grade mathematics. It focuses on competency-based learning, allowing students to progress at their own pace. This approach helps fill gaps in prior knowledge, ensuring that each student builds a solid foundation in math concepts. Levered Learning combines engaging content with assessments that adapt to individual learning needs.

How does the competency-based learning model work in Levered Learning?

The competency-based learning model in Levered Learning allows students to advance through the curriculum based on their mastery of specific skills rather than time spent in class. Students can take assessments to demonstrate their understanding of a topic, and if they need more practice, they can revisit lessons and resources until they feel confident. This personalized approach helps cater to diverse learning styles and paces.

What types of resources and materials does Levered Learning provide for teachers?

Levered Learning provides a comprehensive suite of resources for teachers, including lesson plans, instructional videos, practice exercises, and assessments. These materials are designed to be easily integrated into existing curricula and can be tailored to meet the needs of individual classrooms. Additionally, teachers have access to data analytics that track student progress, helping them identify areas where students may need additional support.

Can Levered Learning be used in a remote or hybrid learning environment?

Yes, Levered Learning is designed to be flexible and can be effectively used in remote, hybrid, or traditional classroom settings. The online platform allows students to access materials from anywhere, making it easy for teachers to assign work and monitor progress regardless of the learning environment. This adaptability ensures that all students can continue their education seamlessly, whether in-person or online.

What industries or educational settings can benefit from Levered Learning?

Levered Learning is primarily focused on elementary education, specifically for grades 3 to 5 in mathematics. It is suitable for public and private schools, tutoring centers, and homeschooling environments. The program is particularly beneficial for educators looking to implement individualized learning strategies and for schools aiming to enhance their math curriculum with a competency-based approach.

How can parents get involved in their child's learning with Levered Learning?

Parents can play an active role in their child's learning by using the Levered Learning platform to monitor progress and engage with the materials. The system provides insights into what skills their child is mastering and where they may need additional help. Parents can support their child's learning by encouraging them to practice regularly, discussing math concepts at home, and celebrating their achievements as they progress through the curriculum.

About Envistacom

Envistacom is a privately held business headquartered in Duluth, Georgia. The company provides communications, cyber, and intelligence solutions and services to U.S. and coalition partners in the aerospace, defense, and intelligence communities.  
  
Envistacom is steadfastly focused on its mission to equip American warfighters with the right solutions and technology to counter existing and emerging threats, as well as protect military personnel, civilians and critical infrastructure, with the ultimate goal to make the world a safer place.  
  
Working primarily with the Department of Defense, Envistacom has more than 440 employees in 15 countries; and multiple IDIQ contracts worth more than $137 billion. Our workforce is comprised of approximately 50% military veterans. The company has been recognized as a top 10 "Pacesetter" and a "Best Place to Work" by the Atlanta Business Chronicle and as one of the top 10 fastest-growing companies in Georgia’s upper-middle market by the Atlanta chapter of the Association for Corporate Growth. In 2020, Envistacom was selected as one of the Top 40 Innovative Technology Companies in Georgia by the Technology Association of Georgia (TAG) and a Military Times’ "Best for Vets" employer.  
  
The company’s Georgia presence also includes the Envistacom Innovation Center, a 30,000-sq.ft. facility that offers strategic support as an innovation and rapid-prototyping facility to develop solutions for customers across the U.S. Department of Defense (DoD) and global intelligence communities.

About METZ CONNECT USA Inc.
---------------------------

METZ CONNECT USA is a manufacturer of high quality products that bring communication capability from the PCB to the Internet. With three product lines, we serve a large segment of the market including the rapidly growing Industrial Ethernet networks.  
  
For manufacturers of electronic devices, connectors from our U|Contact product family are well-known for use in power signal and communication applications. Spring and screw terminal blocks, RJ45 jacks and board to board connectors are part of this portfolio which were previously known under the brand name RIA CONNECT.  
  
For structured cabling networks, our P|Cabling products provide the best in both traditional facility wiring and also a wide offering of industrial Ethernet products. Products include jacks and plugs that require no special tools for installation and data center 19" patch panels. We specialize in Cat. 6A systems in both markets as well as fiber optic systems.  
  
For building automation systems, our C|Logline products offer a range of DIN rail mounted I/O for BACnet, Modbus, Lonworks and other networks. They provide a compact and easy solution to adding points or extending the network into remote areas. Both our P|Cabling and C|Logline products were previously labeled under the brand name of BTR NETCOM.

About Young Audiences New York
------------------------------

Young Audiences New York wants all children in our city to experience and create art!  
  
We provide distinctive opportunities across the arts - music, dance, theatre, visual and digital art - for children and teens from kindergarten through high school.  
  
Each year, our profressional, practicing artists teach more than 45,000 children and youth in New York City's public schools and community centers. For many of these children and their families, Young Audiences New York provides their only access to the arts.  
  
We believe that no matter what kind of work today’s children will go on to do as tomorrow’s grown-ups, they will need to be confident experimenting and innovating, influencing others, expressing new ideas, thinking globally, and teaming up with a diversity of people to make things happen. Young Audiences New York helps children develop these important 21st century skills through programs led by our talented and diverse company of professional Artist Educators and key relationships with school and community partners, donors, and funders.

A.I.S., Inc (AIS) supports the stewardship of our nation's ocean resources and their habitats. AIS has established itself as a leader in federal professional and technical services as well as developing environmental monitoring plans for offshore activities that require certification of compliance. Adams' talent is not limited to the silver screen. In 2016, she made her Broadway debut in a revival of "The Glass Menagerie," wowing audiences with her stage presence and captivating performance. Her ability to seamlessly transition between mediums demonstrates her versatility as an actress.  
  
Outside of her incredible body of work, Adams is also known for her philanthropic efforts. About Christian Bale

Christian Bale is a dynamic and versatile actor who has captivated audiences with his incredible range and commitment to his craft. With an intense and chameleon-like ability to transform himself physically and emotionally for each role, Bale has become one of the most respected and celebrated actors of his generation. From his breakout performance in "American Psycho" to his stunning portrayal of Batman in Christopher Nolan's Dark Knight trilogy, Bale continues to push the boundaries of what it means to be a dedicated performer.  
  
Born on January 30, 1974, in Haverfordwest, Wales, Bale was exposed to show business from an early age. His mother was a circus performer, and his father worked as a talent manager. With a natural talent for acting and a desire to entertain, Bale made his acting debut at the age of 13 in the Steven Spielberg film "Empire of the Sun." This early role showcased his precocious talent and set the stage for his future success.  
  
Bale's commitment to his craft is unrivaled, often completely transforming himself physically for his roles. Perhaps his most notable transformation came in 2004's "The Machinist," where he lost over 60 pounds to portray an emaciated insomniac. The extreme weight loss shocked audiences and demonstrated Bale's dedication to his roles. He quickly followed this transformative performance with his iconic portrayal of Batman in Christopher Nolan's "Batman Begins" in 2005. Bale's intense and brooding performance breathed new life into the iconic character, grounding him in a gritty reality that audiences hadn't seen before.  
  
While Bale is best known for his dramatic roles, he has also shown an impressive range in various genres. In 2005, he starred in the musical "The New World," showcasing his ability to adapt to different styles of performances. He proved that he could hold his own alongside the likes of Terrence Malick, demonstrating a softer and more vulnerable side to his acting abilities. Bale's portrayal of Dicky Eklund in "The Fighter" also demonstrated his versatility, earning him an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor. He expertly captured the essence of a washed-up former boxer struggling with addiction.  
  
Bale's talent isn't limited to his physical transformations; he brings a depth and complexity to his characters that place him in a league of his own. In "American Psycho," Bale played the charismatic but sociopathic Patrick Bateman, whose dark and twisted desires both repel and fascinate audiences. His ability to embody Bateman's sinister charm while also conveying his underlying madness made the character one of the most memorable performances of his career.  
  
Beyond his remarkable acting abilities, Bale is also known for his professionalism and dedication to his work. Directors and fellow actors frequently praise his work ethic and attention to detail. He immerses himself completely in his roles, dedicating countless hours to research and preparation. From perfecting accents to mastering physical mannerisms, Bale becomes fully consumed by his characters. This commitment has resulted in numerous awards and nominations, including an Academy Award for his role in "The Fighter."  
  
Throughout his career, Bale has consistently chosen roles that challenge him as an actor and push him outside of his comfort zone. He's shown a willingness to take risks and tackle controversial subjects, such as his role as Patrick Bateman in "American Psycho" or his portrayal of former U.S. Vice President Dick Cheney in "Vice." By delving into complex and morally ambiguous characters, Bale forces audiences to question their own beliefs and perceptions.  
  
Off-screen, Bale is known for his privacy and unwillingness to conform to Hollywood norms. He's notoriously private about his personal life and avoids the spotlight whenever possible. Bale's dedication to his craft and refusal to let fame define him have only further solidified his status as a respected actor. Despite his reticence towards the limelight, Bale's work continues to capture the attention and praise of critics and audiences alike.  
  
In summary, Christian Bale's extraordinary talent, commitment to his craft, and transformative performances have set him apart as one of the most gifted actors of his generation. From his early breakthrough in "Empire of the Sun" to his powerful portrayal of Batman in the Dark Knight trilogy, Bale consistently pushes the boundaries of his abilities. His ability to physically and emotionally transform himself to fully embody his characters is unmatched, captivating audiences and earning him critical acclaim. With every new role, Christian Bale proves himself as a truly exceptional actor, pushing the boundaries of what is possible and setting the bar higher for future generations of performers.

About Maxsar Digital Studios/Philippe Martinez Productions
----------------------------------------------------------

Maxsar Partners is a media conglomerate based in the Metro Detroit, Michigan area and is comprised of several symbiotic divisions which share a unified mission: to produce films and television series of the highest creative quality and commercial viability with a Michigan workforce. Fashioned after the traditional Studio System of Hollywood's Golden Era, Maxsar Partners takes full advantage of the abilities of each company to bring a project from concept to distribution.  
  
Maxsar Digital Studios in Livonia, Michigan is the home of our 55,000 square foot full service sound stage. Our green screen capability facilitates shooting state of the art projects which are fulfilled by our highly trained staff of CGI artists.  
  
With a fully staffed creative team of the highest caliber, Philippe Martinez Productions conceives, develops, and writes both feature films and television series with its own in house writing department. Once a project is in the can, it is turned back over to Maxsar Digital Studios' editing and post production departments.  
  
The finished product is then handed off to Cinepro Pictures, our international and domestic distribution department whose seasoned sales team uses their twenty plus years of film sales experience to get the project in front of eyes all around the world.  
  
The only old-fashioned, full service, in house media development studio of its kind in the US, Maxsar Partners is proud to share our work with you. Please take a moment to peruse our websites.

About Ruokun Huang

Ruokun Huang serves as the Senior Vice President and Director of Fixed Income Quantitative Research at AllianceBernstein, where he plays a pivotal role in shaping the firm’s investment strategies through advanced quantitative methodologies. With a robust background in financial modeling and data analysis, Ruokun leads a talented team that leverages cutting-edge tools such as R, SAS, and T-SQL to drive insights and optimize portfolio management. His expertise in utilizing the Bloomberg API and Shiny applications allows for the development of sophisticated models that enhance decision-making processes and risk assessment in fixed income markets.  
  
Under Ruokun’s leadership, the fixed income quantitative research team is currently engaged in several key projects aimed at improving predictive analytics and enhancing the firm’s overall investment performance. These initiatives include the development of innovative algorithms for bond pricing and yield forecasting, as well as the implementation of machine learning techniques to identify market inefficiencies. Ruokun’s commitment to integrating technology with traditional finance not only positions AllianceBernstein at the forefront of the industry but also empowers clients with data-driven insights that inform their investment strategies.  
  
With a keen understanding of market dynamics and a passion for quantitative finance, Ruokun Huang continues to push the boundaries of fixed income research, ensuring that AllianceBernstein remains a leader in delivering superior investment outcomes. His ability to translate complex data into actionable strategies exemplifies his expertise and dedication to excellence in the ever-evolving landscape of fixed income investing.

Created in 1993, Tanager draws on ACDI/VOCA’s experience conducting market systems analysis and driving agribusiness development that equips people to build healthy families, resilient communities, and flourishing societies. Through our on-the-ground knowledge and strong networks, we build reliable, efficient supply chains that enable companies to sustainably source their agricultural products to improve the livelihoods of enterprising producers.  
  
Our approach recognizes the potential for real change when we bridge the divide between stakeholders. For more than 20 years, we have developed local, tailored solutions rooted in creating business value for our partners and expanding economic opportunities for smallholder farmers.  
  
Building on ACDI/VOCA’s technical knowledge, Tanager provides advisory services to facilitate socially responsible market systems. Tanager designs and tests new ways of working in agricultural development to unleash the economic potential of market systems to confront poverty, inequality, and malnutrition.  
  
Informing our technical approach and solutions are three core beliefs:  
  
• There is significant untapped potential for growth among smallholder producers and agribusinesses.  
  
• Businesses can profit while contributing to the greater good and sustainably solving today’s pressing development challenges.  
  
• Lasting, inclusive transformation is realized through practical, mutually beneficial business solutions.

-----------

AZmed has been the first French company to commercialize AI-powered radiology software.  
  
For the last 10 years, the number of medical imaging acts has been multiplied by 2 in OECD countries, whereas the number of specialists able to analyze this flow of information has stagnated. Thus, radiologists have less and less time to take the right decision and less time with the patient themselves.    
  
AZmed facilitates trauma and chest X-ray diagnostics thanks to artificial intelligence. It helps doctors save time and dedicate resources to life-threatening exams.  
  
Deep learning technologies as developed by AZmed are fully integrated into doctors’ workflow, making them easy to use, without requiring any change in their work habits. We differentiate by focusing on low-level exams, to enable doctors to improve their daily productivity and optimize their workflows.  
  
AZmed solutions are already used in more than 650 healthcare institutions. More than 3500 doctors are using the solution on a daily basis, in 26 different countries and 5 continents.  
  
 AZmed’s teams are working side by side with radiologists in order to shape the future of medical imaging.

AZmed takes the security and privacy of patient data very seriously. About RoboDK
------------

RoboDK software makes it easy to simulate and program industrial robots. With RoboDK you can simulate over 700 robots from 50 different robot manufacturers and generate error-free robot programs for any robot controller. RoboDK is a powerful and cost-effective simulator for robot arms.  
  
With RoboDK you can easily use any robot for any manufacturing application, such as robot machining, milling, welding, painting, 3D printing, calibrating robots, and more.  
  
RoboDK Software includes all the tools required for Off-Line Programming (OLP) tool. OLP (or Off-Line Programming) means programming robots outside the production environment. OLP eliminates production downtime caused by shop floor programming. OLP is the best way to maximize return on investment for robot systems and requires appropriate simulation tools. The time for the adoption of new programs can be cut from weeks to a single day, enabling the automation of short-run production.  
  
Download RoboDK and start your first project with the free trial!

About HOME of Texas
-------------------

HOME of Texas is an affiliate of Residential Warranty Company LLC and has been providing 10 year warranties to Texas builders since 1981. Texas offers unique challenges to the building industry and HOME of Texas addresses these risks with realistic and effective coverage. Various options exist based on a builder’s needs. HOME of Texas options include 10 year major structural warranties, 10 year enhanced coverage warranties, and remodeler warranties.  
  
10 Year New Home Warranties provided by HOME of Texas are third party insured warranties, providing a specific set of written standards to spell out coverage. Ten year warranties are an effective way to deal with a variety of issues including customer service, marketing, government-financed loans and mandated new home legislation.  
  
The coverage provided by a HOME of Texas 10 year new home warranty includes: 1 Year of Coverage on Workmanship & Materials, 2 Years of Coverage on Selected Portions of Mechanical Systems and 10 Years of Coverage on Major Structural Components. Builder liability is limited to two years and every HOME of Texas warranty product provides an effective dispute resolution system which includes free mediation. If needed, a formal binding arbitration process is also available.

UPI is a digital news and photo provider with a legacy of over 100 years of objective global reporting. Our news feeds are carried by a variety of publishers, research databases, mobile providers and more.  
  
UPI.com reaches millions of readers a month, with continuously updated coverage of the most important news of the day, as well as in-depth reporting, and developments in entertainment, science, health, sports and key industries like defense. The company is based in Boca Raton, Fla., and Washington, D.C.  
  
Founded in 1907 by E.W. Scripps as the United Press news agency, it became known as UPI after a merger with the International News Service in 1958, which was founded in 1909 by William Randolph Hearst.

About Teekay
------------

Teekay is an operational leader and project developer in the marine energy space. Established in 1973, Teekay has developed from a regional shipping company into one of the world’s largest marine energy transportation, storage and production companies. We bring energy where it is needed — anywhere in the world — to power the global economy and to improve people’s lives. Teekay Corporation operates in the marine midstream space through its ownership of the general partners and a portion of the outstanding limited partner interests in Teekay LNG Partners L.P. (NYSE:TGP) and Teekay Offshore Partners L.P. (NYSE:TOO). The general partners own all of the outstanding incentive distribution rights. In addition, Teekay has a controlling ownership interest in Teekay Tankers Ltd. (NYSE:TNK) and directly owns a fleet of vessels. The combined Teekay entities manage and operate consolidated assets of over $13 billion, comprised of over 215 liquefied gas, offshore, and conventional tanker assets. With offices in 15 countries and approximately 7,100 seagoing and shore-based employees, Teekay provides a comprehensive set of marine services to the world's leading oil and gas companies. Teekay's common stock is listed on the New York Stock Exchange where it trades under the symbol "TK"​. About Zeep Medical
------------------

Empowering doctors to make the right career choices, from graduation through to retirement.  
  
Empowering you  
  
Your career is perhaps the most important journey you will ever take. We seek to empower you to take control. Whether you are looking for a short-term locum opportunity or a key change in your professional development, the important part of the journey is you.  
  
Locum  
  
The Zeep Locum team are one of the most experienced in Australia. With access to all available locum opportunities, in every hospital, your Zeep Partner will work with you to identify the opportunities that are right for your current situation.  
  
Perm  
  
Following a comprehensive discovery process, your Zeep Permanent Recruitment Partner will unearth all available opportunities that fit your individual career goals and plans. They will be with you every step of the way, coaching you through the entire journey from interview to your first day.  
  
Easy  
  
Looking for employment, be it short term locum or a strategic career move, can have its challenges. We strive to make our processes as easy as we can for both doctors and hospitals, seeking to improve every step of the journey as best we can. We may never be able to make it perfect, but we are going to keep going with our endeavours to make it Easy.  
  
  
Genuine Service  
  
Underlining everything we do is the desire to offer everyone we interact with a personal and genuine service. Zeep was created with a strong customer service culture, soliciting feedback wherever we can. Feedback has enabled our evolution and development, one great example is the introduction of our ‘Zeep Locum Insurance’ cover, a comprehensive travel insurance policy that provides all Zeep locums with extended cover should they have an accident or loss of personal items. We listened to your concerns, and found a solution.

Multipass Solutions is an experienced software vendor and consultancy with 16+ years of project delivery know-how and professional expertise in Enterprise Content Management. We deliver innovative, award winning products that simplify ECM operations, specializing in two primary areas – workforce transformation and end-to-end data migrations. The first includes automated, secure, crowdsource ready document, forms, cheque and invoice processing and customer data extraction, the second cover large scale enterprise content migrations, data cleansing and system integrations and system upgrades delivered typically in heterogeneous IT environments.  
  
Beside our product portfolio, we offer our clients the full palette of professional services, that cover full project life cycles, from IT strategy creation and solution design, trough project management and consulting during the implementation, to maintenance and technical support.  
  
Our products help our clients in Europe and Asia raise business efficiency, lower operating costs and create a modern, unified, secure information environment in line with all necessary requirements of a successful modern enterprise. At Hawkins Design Group, Inc., we take a systematic approach to solar PV design projects. Our process begins with a thorough site assessment to evaluate the potential for solar energy generation. About Blast Off Partners
------------------------

Blast Off Partners es una impulsora “boutique” desde la que gestionamos un pequeño portafolio de startups valorado en más de 13,5 millones de euros. Hemos participado activamente en la creación de 9 nuevas startups y gestionado la financiación de 4 de ellas, captando más de 1,8 millones de euros en forma de financiación privada y pública.  
  
Nuestro objetivo es apoyar la creación y crecimiento de nuevos negocios, acompañar a los emprendedores en sus inicios, contribuir a construir un tejido empresarial solvente y que aporte soluciones al mundo.  
  
¿Qué nos hace diferentes al resto de impulsoras?  
  
\- Sentimos las empresas con las que trabajamos como si fuéramos socios fundadores. Hemos co-fundado 6 de las 9 start-ups con las que hemos trabajado, con una participación minoritaria como incubadora, pero un trabajo intenso como socios.  
  
\- Realizamos todo el trabajo propio de la gestión de financiación: preparación de documentación de rondas, elaboración de informes a inversores como lead investor, preparación de los emprendedores para las entrevistas de inversión, acompañamiento a eventos…  
  
\- Aportamos trabajo en el ámbito de la estrategia empresarial: trabajamos con los emprendedores en la definición e implementación de su modelo de negocio.  
  
\- Una persona especializada de nuestro equipo se involucra en el día a día del proyecto como si fuera parte del equipo de la start-up.  
  
\- Buscamos siempre soluciones, tanto para los emprendedores como para los inversores, aún si tenemos que optar por acciones poco convencionales.  
  
\- Trabajamos con muy pocos proyectos, y la estadística nos dice que eso es un gran riesgo. Pero sólo así podemos involucrarnos de pleno con esos proyectos y atender personalmente a la parte más importante de nuestro servicio: a cada uno de los emprendedores y a cada uno de los inversores que confían en nosotros.

Nefertari Schools started to operate in August 1996.  
The establishment of Nefertari came with a dream of offering a more distinguished and providing quality education at the time.  
  
Why the Name “Nefertari”?  
Nefertari was the favorite wife of King Ramses II at the age of power and prosperity in the ancient times. Nefertari was highly educated and able to both read and write hieroglyphs, a very rare skill at the time. She used these skills in her diplomatic work. That is why she was the only wife that was built a temple for which is one of the most amazing temples up till now.  
More than two decades ago, Nefertari started with a pioneering vision and showed to offer all that is best in the field of education. Ever since, Excellence has become one of our prime goals.  
Nefertari Schools’ solid reputation in addition to the friendly and welcoming environment made the population of the different divisions increase steadily. Now there are 5100 students enrolled.  
As the school has continued to grow and develop through the years, it has catered for different International Divisions:  
\- 1996 (Nefertari Language School - Nefertari American School - IGCSE Department)  
\- 2002 (Lycée International Nefertari)

\- 2009 (Nefertari Deutsche Internationale Schule)  
\- 2014 (Nefertari International Baccalaureate Division )  
\- 2017 (Nefertari International Schools, 6th October City)  
Nefertari International Schools is committed to continuing to develop with more enthusiasm and developed vision.
